name: smartstrip-portal
description: Responsive web portal for controlling smart power strips (LG MTTL-W01 style) - fleet control, power monitoring, automations, notifications.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
